name: Hierarchical Gaussian Generation with Densify
definition: A method to generate 3D Gaussians in a hierarchical structure from coarse level l-1 to fine level l, regularizing position and scale to stabilize GAN training and manage multi-scale details.
summary: Hierarchical Gaussian Generation with Densify stabilizes GAN training by constructing a coarse-to-fine Gaussian hierarchy where fine-level primitives are derived from coarse ones via residual updates.
